description: This file defines the EmployeeLanguageDecorator class which provides an interface for decorating EmployeeLanguage entities, adding methods to retrieve fluency and competency labels, and to associate employees and languages by ID or number. It is part of the Employee Language management within the HRM system.

classes.name: EmployeeLanguageDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class providing additional methods for EmployeeLanguage entity, such as retrieving fluency and competency descriptions and setting associated Employee and Language entities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with an EmployeeLanguage entity.

methods.name: getFluency
methods.description: Returns the label for the employee's language fluency, or null if undefined.

methods.name: getCompetency
methods.description: Returns the label for the employee's language competency, or null if undefined.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity with the EmployeeLanguage by employee number.

methods.name: setLanguageById
methods.description: Associates a Language entity with the EmployeeLanguage by language ID.
